Caveat: consolidated balance sheet includes consolidated-fund/CLO items; corporate-only leverage is modest. Treat net_debt/nd_ebitda as approximate.

VALUATION: fwd_pe ~19.8 (StockAnalysis); GuruFocus showed ~20.8 (Jun 20). fwd_pe_5y_avg is ESTIMADO ~25 (clean forward-PE 5y average not obtainable from primary sources; BX forward P/E has historically averaged low-to-mid 20s; trailing-P/E 5y avg is much higher at ~41 per Public.com but is NOT apples-to-apples with a forward multiple). pe_prem_disc ~-21% is therefore an ESTIMATE; on a trailing basis the discount vs the 5y avg is far larger (~-50%). peg null (no clean forward growth consensus captured). TREAT VALUATION DISCOUNT AS DIRECTIONAL: BX is clearly trading well below its multi-year average multiple.

DROP CLASSIFICATION = MIXED. Stock ~-35% from 52w high ($190.09) and ~-39% from ATH ($200.96, Nov 25 2024). Predominantly FEAR/ROTATION: 2026 private-credit redemption scare (BCRED $82B fund outflows; Partners Group capping withdrawals triggered sector-wide PE/alt-manager sell-off in KKR/Apollo/Ares/Blue Owl) — sentiment/contagion, NOT a collapse in BX fundamentals (Q1'26 DE +25%, FRE +23%, record AUM, strong inflows). BUT a genuine-deterioration overlay exists: real risk to forward realizations, fundraising and private-credit flows if the credit cycle worsens, plus rising equity-based comp. Net: de-rating is mostly fear-driven multiple compression on strong-but-decelerating fundamentals -> classified MIXED (leans fear_rotation).
